name: Windows widgets and Edge side panel
plain: An installed app can show a small card in the Windows Widgets Board or pin itself to the Edge sidebar.
meaning: Microsoft Edge only. The widgets member lets a service worker update Adaptive Card widgets. The edge_side_panel member lets the app load in the Edge sidebar and announce itself with a Sec-CH-UA brand.

access.prompt_ui: You add a widget from the board, or pin the app to the sidebar

edge.note: Windows 11 only. Microsoft says to check the docs for the current state of the sidebar feature

data.metric: An installed app can show a small card in the Windows Widgets Board or pin itself to the Edge sidebar.

limits.headline: Can put a live card on your Windows desktop board, on Edge only
limits.user_action: None, the page reads it silently
can: Update a widget card from a service worker
Load in the Edge sidebar and be told so by a Client Hint brand
cannot: Add a widget or pin itself without you
limits.reach_label: A widget card and a sidebar slot

story.what_it_is: A web app can place a small live card on the Windows desktop board and live in the Edge sidebar.

marketing.name: PWA widgets in Windows 11
marketing.pitch: Installed PWAs can show Adaptive Card widgets in the Widgets Board.

story.for_you: You decide whether a site's card appears on your Windows board. It can then refresh in the background.
story.for_makers: Makers add a glanceable view of their app that reaches users without opening it.

use_cases.example: A flight tracker keeps a status card on the Windows board.
A news reader shows headlines in the board.

risks: A widget keeps a service worker active

technical_bounds: The sidebar feature state is subject to change per Microsoft
